info.title: OpenDocs API
info.description: Publish Markdown to shareable links and export PDF/DOCX. Agents: read https://opendocs.cc/skill.md first. Send `X-OpenDocs-Client: <agent>` on every request. Errors are `{error, message, docs_url}`. Machine-readable reference for the public OpenDocs API surface used by agents, scripts, the OpenDocs CLI, and dashboard integrations.

get.summary: Inspect the authenticated user, onboarding state, active workspace, and document quota

post.description: Accepts JSON by default. Send Accept: text/event-stream to receive per-document progress events.

schema.description: Server-Sent Events: one `result` frame per document (the same object as a JSON result, with url and publicUrl on success) and a final `summary` frame.

get.description: Any member. The domain, its status, the DNS records to add and the last check's result. `domain` is null when there is none.

404.description: Not a member of the workspace (not_found).

put.summary: Connect or replace the workspace's custom domain
put.description: Owners and admins, on Pro or Team. Checks the records straight away. The same hostname again keeps its verification token and re-checks; a different one replaces the domain with a new token and ends sign-ins on the old one.

hostname.description: e.g. notes.example.com. A pasted URL is accepted; only the hostname is kept.

403.description: forbidden (members), or plan_required (Free workspace, with tier).

404.description: Not a member of the workspace (not_found).

409.description: domain_taken: another workspace has this domain active.

patch.description: Owners and admins, on Pro or Team. For now one setting: whether the domain's footer shows "Published with OpenDocs" (false for a white-label site).

403.description: forbidden (members), or plan_required (Free workspace, with tier).

404.description: Not a member of the workspace (not_found).

delete.description: Owners and admins. Stops serving the domain and ends sign-ins on it.

200.description: Removed, or there was nothing to remove (removed: false).

404.description: Not a member of the workspace (not_found).

post.summary: Check the custom domain's DNS records now
post.description: Owners and admins. 12 checks a minute per account. A failed check on an active domain is reported in lastError but doesn't count toward the three failures that stop it serving; only the background check every 6 hours does.

200.description: The domain after the check, or domain: null when there is none.

404.description: Not a member of the workspace (not_found).

201.description: API key created. The plaintext key is returned once.

get.description: Brand color, font, logo and footer used in PDF/DOCX exports, plus the available presets, fonts and contrast guidelines. Accepts API keys.

schema.description: Current export theme plus presets, fonts and guidelines.

patch.description: Apply a preset and/or set brandColor, font, showLogoInExports and footer fields in one write. Owners and admins on any plan; footer fields need Pro or Team (Free exports keep the "Made with OpenDocs" footer). Brand colors lighter than 4.5:1 against white are refused with low_contrast unless allowLowContrast is true.

InvalidRequest.description: The request body or parameters failed validation.

Forbidden.description: The caller is authenticated but not allowed to perform this action.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with existing state.

Gone.description: The requested token or resource has expired.

BillingFailed.description: Billing could not be updated for this action.

DocumentLimit.description: The action would exceed the workspace document limit.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required service is not configured or unavailable.

docs_url.description: Where the error code is explained, https://docs.opendocs.cc/errors#<code>.

publicUrl.description: Absolute link to share. The workspace's custom domain when the domain is active (any visibility; readers of documents that aren't public sign in there) (e.g. https://notes.example.com/plan), otherwise the opendocs.cc URL.

previousSlug.description: The slug before the move, when it changed.

name.description: Full record name, e.g. notes.example.com or _opendocs.notes.example.com.

host.description: The same name relative to the domain (notes, _opendocs.notes, or @), for DNS providers that ask for that.

value.description: custom.opendocs.cc, an IPv4 address, or opendocs-verify=<token>.

check.description: Result of the last check for this record; null before the first check.

CustomDomain.description: A workspace's custom domain for its reader pages.

status.description: DNS status as stored. misconfigured after three scheduled checks in a row failed.

state.description: What the dashboard shows. verifying: records found in the last 10 minutes, the certificate is issued on the first visit. paused: the workspace's plan doesn't include custom domains.

serving.description: True when the domain serves the workspace's pages right now.

showPoweredBy.description: Whether the domain's footer shows "Published with OpenDocs". Change it with PATCH /api/v1/workspace/domain.

domain.description: null when the workspace has no custom domain.

allowed.description: Whether the workspace's plan includes custom domains (Pro and Team).
